# Review of the methods

## Summary

The draft counts fear words and key terms in six works and checks its dictionary on a hand-read sample. Keyness is limited to words in at least two later works, which keeps one work's names out of the list.

## Points to address

1. Report the earlier period's key terms as well, so the reader sees both directions.
2. Give an interval for the precision of 0.75 (20 items is a small sample).

## DIMENSION SCORES
- Overall: 8/10

OVERALL SCORE: 8/10
RECOMMENDATION: Minor Revision
